title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
active_desc: Your account is protected with two-factor authentication via an authenticator app.
inactive_desc: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a code from your phone when logging in.
instructions: Scan the QR code with your favorite authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, etc).
manual_entry_help: If you cannot scan, enter the key above in your app.
recovery_codes_warning: Keep these codes in a safe place. Each one allows you to access the dashboard if you lose your phone.
verify_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code generated by your authenticator app to confirm activation.
disable_warning: By disabling two-factor authentication, your account will only be protected by your password.
disable_code_help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or one of your single-use backup recovery codes.
login_instruction: Enter the 6-digit code generated by your authenticator app or use a recovery code.
enter_code: Please enter the authentication or recovery code.
setup_qr_desc: Scan the QR code with your favorite authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, etc).
backup_codes_desc: Store these codes in a safe place. Each one allows you to access the dashboard if you lose your phone.
confirm_code_desc: Enter the 6-digit code generated by your authenticator app to confirm activation.
disable_warning_desc: Disabling two-factor authentication will leave your account protected only by your password.
